name: Add fuzzy finding for stories
description:
- Add a fuzzy finder feature to search for stories
- Search across all fields
- Add a search bar input in the header. It should act as a button and only visually look like an input. Use emoji for icon
- When a user presses "CTRL + F" or clicks the input in the header, open a modal that shows a fuzzy finder, text input at top, list of items at the bottom.
- User can select items by either clicking with mouse of navigating with keyboard and pressing enter.
- When user selects an item, fuzzy finder closes and card comes up.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Factory scope decisions from sunny: default fuzzy search to the current Board. Add a preference toggling search scope between current Board and entire Data Root. Search Story fields plus related Comments, Tasks, Specs, Epics and attachment names. Ctrl+F opens only from main screens; preserve active forms and modals.
